text: Simpson's further statements: the paper, the cravat
why: The paper is explained in ¶58 (Simpson says it was a ten-pound note), and at ¶40 he is unable to account for the cravat found in the dead man's hand.
¶39 says Simpson books bets in London sporting clubs, and ¶58 says the opium was probably brought from London.
¶58 suggests the horse may be at the bottom of one of the pits or old mines on the moor.
¶58 states that Simpson says the paper he gave the maid was a ten-pound note.
¶58 states that one ten-pound note was found in his purse.
